violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: - OBSERVED: mixed cheese was stored in 2-door prep cooler for 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food item.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: (1) seaweed salad (49f), blue cheese dressing (48f) and masago (45f) were stored in 2-door prep cooler (pantry) overnight; (2) shredded five cheese blend (47f) and shredded cheddar cheese (47f) were stored in 1-door flat top cooler (pizza) for 5 hours; (3) blue cheese dressing (44f) was stored in cold well (expo) overnight; (4) cooked mushroom (113f), sautéed onion (99f), and roasted chili pepper (96f) were stored by grill at grill station for about 3 hours; (5) guacamole (43-45f) was stored in 4-drawer prep cooler overnight.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the food items.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): truffle oil, ancho bbq sauce, gochujang sauce, and whiskey glaze.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: time as a public health control procedure has been established.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: - OBSERVED: utensils were stored in a container of stagnant water at 116f at cookline.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: CFM discarded the water. Utensils will be properly wash, rinse and sanitized.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: - OBSERVED: ambient temperature of 1-door flat top cooler (pizza) was 56f.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: immediately stop using the unit and obtain urgent service within 10 calendar days.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. CUMIN ROASTED CHICKEN (42-47F) WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER (PROTEIN) OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM DISCARDED THE CHICKEN.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: SANITIZING STEP OF HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS NOT CONFIRMED. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 154F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
